column1: # Cases in which a vendor answers otherwise than the specification, in a pair
# with ZeroDDS, while ZeroDDS follows the clause with its default (the
# maintainer decided to keep the default, 2026-11-01). Unlike
# vendor-self-failures.tsv the case runs, and it must fail with the codes given
# here; omg_suite.py then counts it as a declared deviation, neither passed nor
# red. A declared case that passes, or fails with other codes, is red: the
# list has gone stale, or something else broke.
# codes: what the harness records as produced, per entity.
# harness (optional): the harness arguments the row holds for, e.g. `-x 1`;

column5: DDS-XTypes 1.3 §7.4.1.2: the parameter length is "the exact length of the serialized member. It does not account for any padding bytes"; Cyclone writes 4 for the one-octet members of a @mutable struct under XCDR1 (the length DDSI-RTPS 2.5 §9.4.2.11 gives RTPS parameters), and ZeroDDS' default reader refuses it; wire.pl_cdr1_reading=tolerant takes it
column7: the ZeroDDS client reports 'at 13: … parameter length that stops at the value (XTypes 1.3 §7.4.1.2) and the stream has 4 for 1 byte(s)'; with ZERODDS_WIRE_PL_CDR1_READING=tolerant the case passes under -x 1 with TypeObject versions 1 and 2 (Linux test host, 2026-11-08, fork bcde843 of the suite at 4529036); GitHub run 42409104808
